mara:
Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent game environment atlas, six isolated objects in a clear 3-column 2-row layout. Reference image is our existing cottage furniture, STYLE ONLY. Match its warm storybook pixel art, chunky pixel clusters, dark brown edges, cream ceramics, timber, earthy sage/terracotta. Front-facing farming-game view with slight top surface visible. Upper-left lighting. No people, text, labels, room background, borders or checkerboard. Actual transparency and generous gaps, no touching objects.
TOP ROW left to right: (1) a wooden wall shelf holding stacked cream plates, two little jars and a copper pan hanging beneath; (2) a small round rustic wooden kitchen clock with cream face, simple hands and dots instead of numbers; (3) three bunches of drying kitchen herbs tied to a short wooden wall rail.
BOTTOM ROW left to right: (4) an open well-used recipe book on a low wooden stand, cream pages with tiny abstract scribbles and a little carrot sketch, no legible words; (5) a small oval tea tray with cream teapot and two matching mugs, top surface visible; (6) a folded rust-and-cream gingham tea towel with a tiny wooden rolling pin resting beside it, as one compact worktop arrangement.
Each object must be completely inside its own atlas region, clean transparent padding, cosy original game art matching the reference. No furniture bodies, floor, actors, baked-in shadows or new character artwork.

Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent game environment atlas, six isolated objects in a clear 3-column 2-row layout. Reference image is our existing cottage furniture, STYLE ONLY. Match its warm storybook pixel art, chunky pixel clusters, dark brown edges, warm timber and terracotta with sage/moss green. Front-facing farming-game view with slight top surface visible. Upper-left lighting. No people, text, labels, room background, borders or checkerboard. Actual transparency and generous gaps, no touching objects.
TOP ROW left to right: (1) a wooden wall shelf holding three mismatched terracotta pots with leafy plants, one little trailing vine hangs below; (2) a short wooden wall rail with a small copper watering can, hand trowel and garden twine hanging from pegs; (3) two small adjacent warm wooden frames displaying pressed wildflowers, pale cream backing, no writing.
BOTTOM ROW left to right: (4) a shallow wooden seedling tray with six little green sprouts in soil cells, top visible; (5) a round terracotta pot of bushy fresh herbs with a little cream plant marker, no writing; (6) a flat oval woven sage rug with a cream-and-ochre little flower border, viewed from the same shallow overhead game perspective, no raised folds, no furniture.
Each object must be completely inside its own atlas region with clean transparent padding; no character artwork, no scenery. These are personal gardening decorations, not seed packets or collectible produce.
